title: Replace dotenv with Bun-native env loading — remove unnecessary .env dependency
description: The .env file contains a real GitHub PAT and is in the working tree, but .gitignore properly excludes it and `git log --all -- .env` confirms it was never committed to git history. However, the code uses `dotenv` to load from `.env` (src/index.ts:126, scripts/set-folder-dates.ts:59) which is unnecessary — Bun auto-loads environment variables from .env files natively. The dotenv dependency adds weight and .env file management is redundant when the user can simply `export GITHUB_TOKEN=...` or rely on Bun's built-in .env loading.
spec:
1. Remove the `import { config as loadDotenv } from 'dotenv'` and the `loadDotenv()` call from src/index.ts:2 and src/index.ts:126.
2. Remove the `import { config as loadDotenv } from 'dotenv'` and the `loadDotenv()` call from scripts/set-folder-dates.ts:3 and scripts/set-folder-dates.ts:59.
3. Remove the `dotenv` dependency from package.json devDependencies/dependencies.
4. Run `bun install` to update the lockfile.
5. Update README.md Configuration section: remove the '.env.example to .env' copy instruction; instruct users to either (a) create a .env file with GITHUB_TOKEN (Bun auto-loads it) or (b) set the GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable via their shell profile or inline `GITHUB_TOKEN=xxx bun run sync`.
6. Verify `bun test` passes.
7. Verify `bun run smoke:qc` passes.
